action.description: The tool the actor runs or waits on, and its target; null before any (H14).

target.description: What the tool works on: a path in the worktree or a command's summary (H14).

tool.description: The tool, as the agent harness names it.

error.description: The error that ended the last turn, else null.

harness.description: The coding agent harness whose hooks wrote the record, such as `claude-code` (S11).

key.description: The record's file name without `.json`, unique in the pool.

label.description: The session title, `session HH:MM`, or the subagent's type (H16).

launched_by.description: The `key` of the session of another agent whose harness process this session's harness process descends from, read from the process table; absent without one (S17).

model.description: The newest model the actor used, as its harness names it, such as `claude-opus-5-5`; absent when unknown (S11, H32).

outputs.description: The actor's running background tasks, newest first, then the one that ended last; absent when it has none (S13).

placed_by.description: `cwd` when placed by its working folder, `path` when a path it used moved it (H10).

reason.description: What a waiting actor waits for, else null.

since.description: When the record's state last changed.

updated.description: When the record's last event came.

name.description: The words of the heavy pattern the build process matches.

queued.description: Whether a live job's process is the build or one of its ancestors, also true for a build only a suggestion names.

count.description: A count, null when git could not tell.

dirty.description: Files `git status` lists as changed or untracked.

operation.description: A git operation stopped half way, null when there is none.

unknown.description: Whether git could not tell some of these facts.

unreferenced.description: Commits on a detached HEAD that no branch, tag, remote branch or wtpool backup holds.

pattern.description: The pattern, one to three words.

source.description: The list it comes from: the machine's, the repository's `heavy` or its `build_processes`.

actor.description: The key of the actor of this pool it belongs to, else null.

id.description: The job's id, or an id of a heavy process outside any job.

since.description: When it started, or for a waiting job when it queued.

summary.description: The words of the heavy pattern it matches, else the summary of its arguments.

worktree.description: The path of the worktree of this pool its folder lies in, else null.

config.description: The path of `machine.toml`, whether it exists or not.

default.description: The limit without a setting: a quarter of the cores, kept from 1 to 8.

enforce.description: The policy for heavy commands outside a job.

error.description: Why the machine config or the job folder cannot be read, else null.

heavy.description: Each heavy pattern with the list it comes from.

limit.description: How many jobs run at once, null while error is set.

outside.description: The outermost heavy processes no job holds, newest first.

source.description: Where the limit and the policy each come from: `machine.toml` or the defaults.

suggested.description: This repository's suggested patterns that the heavy list lacks.

waiting.description: The waiting jobs in queue order.

ended.description: When wtpool learned that the task ended (H27); null while it runs.

path.description: The absolute path of the file the harness writes the task's output to, on this machine; wtpool names it and never reads it (H27).

running.description: Whether the task still runs, by the harness's own list of tasks in flight (H27).

summary.description: The command's summary: its program and one subcommand (H14).

task.description: The task's id, as the agent harness names it.

agents.description: `on` when `wtpool-activity/` exists in the common git directory, so agent hooks record activity (S8).

github.description: `<owner>/<repo>`, read offline from the remote's URL; null when that is no github.com URL.

name.description: The folder name of the main worktree.

skipped_records.description: Activity records skipped for an unknown version or a parse error (S6).

worktrees.description: Every worktree of the repository, in `git worktree list` order.

from.description: What suggested it, such as the marker `Cargo.toml` or `package.json`; an open string.

activity.description: What the worktree is doing or, without activity, whether it is available (A4, A5).

actors.description: The agent sessions and subagents shown in the worktree, newest event first.

branch.description: The branch checked out, null when detached or unknown.

builds.description: The build processes working in the worktree (S4).

free.description: Whether `wtpool bg` would take the worktree (S9).

git.description: What git says of the worktree.

last_change.description: The last change of the worktree's `HEAD` or index (A6).

last_event.description: The newest `updated` of any record placed in the worktree, shown or not (A6).

path.description: The worktree's folder, as git lists it.

reasons.description: Why `wtpool bg` would not take it, in this order (S9).

upstream.description: The branch's upstream, null without one.

description: One line of `wtpool status --json`, or a line of `wtpool status --watch` with type status. Generated from the types of wtpool-core and printed by `wtpool status --schema`. Within version 1 documents only gain properties; ignore the ones you do not know.

jobs.description: This user's heavy jobs on the machine; absent without a folder for their settings.

name.description: The machine's host name, `localhost` when it has none.

pools.description: The pools of the document; `wtpool status` prints one.

version.description: The document version, bumped only by a removal or a rename.

title: wtpool status document
